items.title: Royal Thai Embassy (Singapore) Spun Pile Export & Deep Foundation QA/QC
items.scope: Cross-border export supply and technical compliance verification of high-strength prestressed concrete spun piles (Ø400–600 mm, TIS 398-2537 / JIS A5335 standards, concrete strength >500 ksc) for the new Royal Thai Embassy diplomatic complex foundation in Singapore.
items.deliverables: Pre-pour batching logs, centrifuge speed curing verification dossiers, high-strain dynamic formula verification records, export bill of lading QA release dossier, and third-party compliance verification letter.

items.title: Central Festival EastVille Large Commercial Complex Precast Deep Foundation
items.location: Pradit Manutham Road, Bangkok Soft Clay Basin
items.scope: Heavy precast foundation spun pile manufacturing, staged logistics, and vibration-controlled hydraulic static pressing (JIP Jack-In Pile system) in Bangkok soft clay for the Central Festival EastVille retail development. Elimination of surrounding residential noise and micro-vibration hazards.
items.deliverables: Continuous hydraulic jack pressure-penetration settlement records, pile-soil load transfer analysis, structural integrity records, and statutory foundation completion sign-off.

items.organization: Roge & Associates Co., Ltd. / PACO Group
items.title: Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) Municipal Bridges & Elevated Box Girders
items.scope: Structural engineering consultation, heavy prestressed concrete box girder fabrication oversight, and foundation stability inspection for municipal elevated road overpasses and canal bridges commissioned by Bangkok Public Works Department (BMA สำนักการโยธา กทม.).
items.deliverables: Prestressed tendon elongation calculation books, concrete compressive strength batch certificates, pier cap load settlement review sheets, and Thai PE stamped statutory inspection dossiers.

items.organization: Roge & Associates Co., Ltd. (Ministry of Finance Grade A Consultant)
